description.value:
The study of runes has enabled you to wield primordial magic. Your knowledge of these runes is stored in your spellbook, though you determine the runes' cosmetic appearance. You can invoke these runes in the following ways:

  • Rune of Renewal. As a Bonus Action, you can choose one creature you can see within 60 feet. That creature regains hit points equal to your Wizard level + your Intelligence modifier and you removal all poisons and diseases affecting it.
  • Rune of Destruction. When you cast a spell that deals damage, you can add your Wizard level + your Intelligence modifier to one damage roll of that spell and change its damage type to force.
  • Rune of Protection. When a creature you can see within 60 feet has to make a Saving Throw, you can use your Reaction to give it a bonus to that roll equal to your Intelligence modifier.
  • Rune of Clarity. As a Bonus Action, you can choose one creature you can see within 60 feet. That creature is under the effect of the Detect Magic and Comprehend Languages spells for the next 24 hours.

You can invoke each rune once. When you finish a Short Rest, you can choose one rune and regain its use. When you finish a Long Rest, you regain the use of all runes.
